name: System Operations
description: System operations and read-only host observability: allow-listed commands, confined files, processes, services, logs and health scans.

env.name: LOOMOPS_ALLOWED_COMMANDS
env.description: Comma/space separated allowlist of executable names for ops_run_command. Empty denies all.

env.name: LOOMOPS_ALLOWED_PATHS
env.description: Comma or ':' separated roots that ops_read_file/ops_write_file may touch. Empty denies all.

env.name: LOOMOPS_AUDIT_LOG
env.description: Path to the JSON-lines audit log (defaults to the plugin-local tmp directory).

env.name: LOOMOPS_COMMAND_TIMEOUT
env.description: Maximum seconds a command may run before it is terminated.

env.name: LOOMOPS_LOG_ROOTS
env.description: Comma or ':' separated roots scanned by the file-log fallback.

env.name: LOOMOPS_MAX_LOG_LINES
env.description: Default number of log lines returned by log tools.

env.name: LOOMOPS_CPU_THRESHOLD
env.description: CPU percent above which ops_scan_health raises a finding.

env.name: LOOMOPS_DISK_THRESHOLD
env.description: Disk used percent above which ops_scan_health raises a finding.

env.name: LOOMOPS_LOAD_THRESHOLD
env.description: Load average per CPU above which ops_scan_health raises a finding.
